# LiveAgent Affiliate Program - Terms and Conditions

Complete terms and conditions for LiveAgent’s affiliate program including partnership levels (Basic, Advanced, Professional), commission rates, requirements, and legal obligations.

## LiveAgent’s Affiliate Program Terms and Conditions

By accessing, participating, or otherwise engaging in the [affiliate program](https://liveagent.com/affiliate-program/), you hereby affirm that:

1. You acknowledge that you have thoroughly read, comprehended, and consented to this Affiliate Partner Agreement (“Agreement”).
2. You possess the legal capacity to form a binding contract with: QualityUnit s.r.o., Vajnorska 100/A, 83104, Bratislava, Slovakia (European Union), Identification number: 35908301 (“QualityUnit”).
3. You have the requisite authority to enter into this Agreement on your behalf or on behalf of the entity you represent. If you do not agree to be bound by this Agreement, you are prohibited from accessing or signing up for the affiliate program.

## Definitions

- **LiveAgent**: A product, trademark and a copyright held by QualityUnit s.r.o.
- **Qualified Referral**: A referral that satisfies the criteria outlined in this Agreement. An Affiliate Partner will be eligible to receive a referral commission only if they submit a referral to QualityUnit that meets the criteria specified in this Agreement (“Qualified Referral”). QualityUnit retains the sole discretion to determine whether a referral qualifies as a Qualified Referral.
- **Negotiation Rights**: Affiliate Partner agrees not to negotiate terms or make commitments on behalf of QualityUnit. QualityUnit shall collect the applicable subscription charges for the QualityUnit Products directly from the Customer.
- **Referral Link**: A URL by QualityUnit utilized for the submission of referrals.
- **Actively Promote**: Engaging in [marketing activities](https://liveagent.com/about/branding/) such as maintaining a microsite, leveraging social media platforms, distributing newsletters, and other promotional activities to advertise LiveAgent, without misrepresenting or impersonating LiveAgent or QualityUnit.
- **Partner**: Any entity or individual partaking in the LiveAgent Partnership Program.
- **Basic Partner**: A partner satisfying the requirements of the Basic level.
- **Advanced Partner**: A partner satisfying the requirements of the Advanced level.
- **Professional Partner**: A partner satisfying the requirements of the Professional level.
- **Annual Commission**: The cumulative commission accrued from existing sales within a given year.
- **Minimal Accounts Sold**: The minimum number of accounts (not agents) sold per affiliate account within one year.
- **Provision Limit**: Commission payment is accounted for from the first payment; the commission is disbursed solely from the paid and utilized amount.
- **Inactivity Limit**: The duration since the last activity, after which the affiliate account is deactivated. Reactivation is permissible, but commissions will not be reinstated.
- **Fixed Cost**: An average fixed cost of 8% levied by our payment processor on each transaction. Commissions are calculated from the remaining 92% of the total order amount.
- **Referral Commission**: A commission disbursed to an individual who introduces new clients or customers to LiveAgent.
- **Sponsored Demo Accounts**: Accounts endowed with the latest features released for the partner’s internal testing purposes.

## Affiliate Partner Responsibilities

Affiliate Partner hereby represents, warrants, and covenants that:

- You must provide your legal full name, a valid email address, and any additional information requested to complete the signup process.
- You are the proprietor of the company and there exists no legal impediment precluding you from entering into a binding agreement.
- You are the proprietor or are duly licensed to utilize all content on your website.
- Your website and/or newsletter do not contravene applicable laws or regulations.
- Your website and/or newsletter do not contain false representations or content that is defamatory or violates any privacy or publicity rights.
- Your website and/or newsletter do not infringe any copyright, trademark, patent, or other proprietary rights.
- You will place our banners on your site as you see fit or within non-spam email
- You are responsible for maintaining the security of your account and password. Quality Unit cannot and will not be liable for any loss or damage from your failure to comply with this security obligation.
- **PROHIBITED**: The use of banners or links in newsgroups, chat rooms, message boards, banner networks, counters, or guestbooks is strictly prohibited.
- **PROHIBITED**: All PPC campaigns, including bidding within PPC systems such as Google Ads or Microsoft Ads and any other suspicious traffic, are strictly prohibited.
- You may not use the Program for any illegal or unauthorized purpose. You must not, in the use of the Affiliate account or Program, violate any laws in your jurisdiction (including but not limited to copyright laws).
- You will not send unsolicited communications, junk email, spam, or other forms of duplicative or unsolicited messages to leads.
- Each legal entity may control no more than one Program account unless expressly authorized.
- You will use only materials provided by QualityUnit for Affiliate Partner’s sales and marketing efforts.
- You will not engage in excessive telemarketing activities to promote QualityUnit Products.
- You will not promote QualityUnit on sites containing unlawful, hateful, violent, abusive, or pornographic content.
- You will not impersonate LiveAgent or QualityUnit.
- You will comply with all applicable laws.
- You acknowledge that QualityUnit reserves the unilateral right to withdraw from the contract in the event of any violation or unethical conduct, with assessment at QualityUnit’s sole discretion.
- If the Affiliate Partner is found to violate these terms and conditions, any outstanding payouts are void, and the agreement is immediately terminated.
- You agree to indemnify, defend, and hold harmless QualityUnit, s.r.o. from any claims, damages, liabilities, and expenses (including reasonable attorney’s fees) arising from your breach of this Agreement, your website, and/or your participation in the affiliate program.

## Partnership Levels and Requirements

| | Basic | Advanced | Professional |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Expectations** | | | |
| Yearly commission | up to 1000 | up to 5000 | more than 5000 |
| Minimal accounts sold yearly | 2 | 3 | 5 |
| Minimal account lifetime needed / months | 3 | 3 | 3 |
| Provision limit | 12 months | 12 months | 12 months |
| Actively promote LiveAgent | not mandatory | | |
| Partner and sales training | not mandatory | | |
| Inactivity limit | 12 months | 12 months | 12 months |
| Fixed cost | 8% | 8% | 8% |
| **Benefits** | | | |
| Referral commission | 10% | 20% | 30% |
| LiveAgent partner logo | LiveAgent Basic partner | LiveAgent Advanced partner | LiveAgent Pro partner |
| Sponsored Demo accounts | 0 | 1 | 3 |
| Dedicated [customer support](https://liveagent.com/customer-service-software/) contact | | | |
| Access to the prerelease list | | | |
| Marketing cooperative activities | | | |

### Basic Partner

- **Commission**: Up to 1000 EUR annually.
- **Sales Requirement**: Minimum of 2 accounts sold yearly.
- **Account Activity**: Each account must be active for at least 3 months.
- **Commission Rate**: 10%.

**Additional Features:**

- No mandatory promotion of LiveAgent.
- No sponsored demo accounts.
- General customer support is available.
- No access to pre-release lists or cooperative marketing activities.

### Advanced Partner

- **Commission**: Up to 5000 EUR annually.
- **Sales Requirement**: Minimum of 3 accounts sold yearly.
- **Account Activity**: Each account must be active for at least 3 months.
- **Commission Rate**: 20%.

**Additional Features:**

- Mandatory promotion through a microsite, social media, or newsletter.
- Use of LiveAgent Advanced Partner logo required.
- One demo account for testing updates.
- General customer support is available.
- Information on new releases via email one week in advance.
- Participation in cooperative marketing activities.

### Professional Partner

- **Commission**: Exceeding 10000 EUR annually.
- **Sales Requirement**: Minimum of 5 accounts sold yearly.
- **Account Activity**: Each account must be active for at least 3 months.
- **Commission Rate**: 30%.

**Additional Features:**

- Mandatory promotion through a microsite, social media, or newsletter.
- Use of LiveAgent Pro Partner logo required.
- Three demo accounts for showcasing features.
- Dedicated customer support contact.
- Early access to forthcoming features.
- Participation in cooperative marketing activities.

## General Terms

- **Compliance**: Partner must comply with all applicable laws and regulations.
- **Non-transferability**: Benefits and obligations of partners are non-transferable.
- **Modification**: QualityUnit reserves the right to modify terms and conditions, including benefits and requirements, at its sole discretion. Notification of changes will be provided to partners.
- **Termination**: QualityUnit reserves the right to terminate participation for any partner not complying with the terms and conditions or for inactivity beyond the defined limits.
- **Confidentiality**: Information shared between QualityUnit and Partner as part of the program is confidential and must not be disclosed to any third party.
- **Governing Law**: These terms and conditions are governed by the laws of the jurisdiction in which QualityUnit operates.
- **Dispute Resolution**: Any disputes arising under these terms will first be attempted to be resolved through negotiation in good faith. If unsuccessful, disputes will be resolved by arbitration in the governing jurisdiction.
- **Limitation of Liability**: QualityUnit’s liability arising out of or related to this Agreement will not exceed the total commission paid or payable to the Affiliate Partner.
- **No Warranty**: QualityUnit makes no express or implied warranties or representations with respect to the affiliate program or any products sold through the program.
- **Exchange Rate and Payouts**: QualityUnit is not responsible for any fluctuations in exchange rates that may affect the value of payouts to partners. All payouts will be made in the agreed-upon currency, and any conversion to another currency is the responsibility of the partner. QualityUnit reserves the right to adjust payout amounts based on significant changes in exchange rates or other financial considerations.

## Privacy Policy

At Quality Unit, we uphold the highest standards of privacy and are committed to safeguarding the personal and business information of our users. We will not disclose any such information to third parties without obtaining explicit consent from you and your company. We ensure that your name, email address, phone number, and any other personal information remain confidential and are not sold to any external entities. We hold this information in strict confidence. Should you have any inquiries regarding your privacy rights, please contact us at [support@QualityUnit.com](mailto:support@QualityUnit.com).

## Affiliate Payment

- QualityUnit assumes responsibility for the disbursement of affiliate commissions and all financial transactions pertinent to the QualityUnit Affiliate Program.
- Commissions are granted for generating authorized sales via your referral links. Prior to placing such links, your application to become an affiliate must be approved by QualityUnit.
- Payouts are issued on the fifteenth (15th) day of each month, provided that your account balance meets the minimum payout threshold of 250 EUR.
- Funds credited to your account do not accrue interest.
- If opting for payout via wire transfer, affiliates are liable for all associated banking fees.
- Affiliates are responsible for providing accurate bank account information. QualityUnit, s.r.o. is not liable for any damages arising from incorrect or missing bank account details provided by the affiliate.
- The affiliate program permits self-purchases; however, to qualify for commission payment, you must refer a minimum of two distinct customers, each placing separate orders.

## Refunds, Chargebacks, and Non-Sufficient Funds

In the event an order is subsequently refunded, a chargeback is initiated by the customer, or a customer’s check is returned due to insufficient funds, the corresponding referral commission and any applicable Affiliate chargeback fees will be subtracted from the subsequent monthly payment issued to the Affiliate.

## Identifying yourself as a LiveAgent affiliate

You may post or advertise your participation in the Program. However, you may not in any manner misrepresent or embellish the relationship between you and LiveAgent (and/or QualityUnit), including, without limitation, expressing or implying that you develop the service LiveAgent provides, expressing or implying you are part of LiveAgent in any way, or expressing or imply any relationship or affiliation between you and LiveAgent except as expressly permitted by this Agreement (including, without limitation, by expressing or implying that LiveAgent supports, sponsors, endorses, or contributes money to any charity or other cause).

## Relationship of Parties

You are an independent contractor, and nothing in this Agreement will create any partnership, joint venture, agency, franchise, sales representative, or [employment relationship](https://liveagent.com/about/career/) between you and LiveAgent. You will have no authority to make or accept any offers or representations on our behalf. You will not make any statement, whether on your site or otherwise, that reasonably would contradict anything in this Agreement, including, without limitation, the relationship between you and LiveAgent.
